module: Dual-clutch gearbox (DCT) logic with automatic modes P R N D S 1 2 M. Loaded by vehicleController when the "gearbox" device is of type dctGearbox. Two shafts (access1/access2: gearIndex1/2, clutchRatio1/2, setGearIndex1/2) alternate: the primary shaft is engaged, the secondary pre-selects the next gear (dctPredictNextGear) and the change crosses the two clutches. Handles rev-match on downshift, launch and the arcade/realistic modes.
notes: jbeam keys read in init: clutchLaunchTargetRPM (3000), clutchLaunchStartRPM (2000), revMatchThrottle (0.5), automaticModes ("PRNDS21M"), defaultAutomaticMode ("N"), autoDownShiftInM (true), dctClutchTime (0.05), defaultForwardMode ("D").

The downshift rev-match sets electrics.values.clutchRatio1/clutchRatio2 to 0 and forces the throttle to revMatchThrottle until the engine speed reaches the target (500 RPM margin) or revMatchExpired (timerConstants) is exceeded.
The next gear is chosen on the secondary shaft; if the wanted gear is not on the same shaft (parity), an "auxiliary" gear is engaged first.
In arcade shiftUp/shiftDown display a warning; shiftToGearIndex switches to realistic (actual: sharedFunctions.switchToRealisticBehavior).
getGearName/getGearPosition follow the same principle as automaticGearbox (mode name, S/M prefixes).
init sets M.minGearIndex = abs(...) but updateExposedData rewrites it signed. M.running is written without declaration.
Common shiftLogic contract: gearboxHandling, timer, timerConstants, inputValues, shiftPreventionData, shiftBehavior, smoothedValues injected by vehicleController.

throttle.desc: Decided throttle (0..1); kept on upshift, cut on downshift except rev-match.

clutchRatio.desc: Overall clutch ratio (per-shaft ratios are in electrics clutchRatio1/2).

currentGearIndex.desc: Current gear or target gear during a change.

updateGearboxGFX.desc: nop then inGear/whileShifting of the active mode.

init.desc: Gets mainEngine and gearbox, builds modes, arcade/realistic logics, clutch and DCT parameters, applies the default forward mode then the current mode. Called by vehicleController (init and reset).

areShiftLEDsInUse.desc: True outside arcade in manual M mode.

getGearName.desc: Displayed gear name (mode, or S/M + gear).

getGearPosition.desc: Normalized lever position and mode index.

setDefaultForwardMode.desc: Sets the default forward mode (D, S, M1...) and applies it if already moving forward.

shiftUp.desc: Realistic: next mode in the list; in manual M shifts up one gear (with over-rev safety if gearboxSafety).

shiftDown.desc: Realistic: previous mode / lower gear in M.

shiftToGearIndex.desc: Realistic: selects the mode matching the lever position.

sendTorqueData.desc: Asks the engine to send its torque curves to the UI.
